name: Nakane Miho
source:
A coworker at the company Chikako works at. She's a designer who designed the clothing Chikako wears. She's friendly and kind to Chikako and helps ease her into the role of being a designer and encourages her to become a model because of her large breasts and excellent figure.

[spoiler]Secretly her job is to train new recruits as sex slaves.

When her old friend Nanako shows up and desperately begs Miho to return home she sells her to the Vagrants.[/spoiler]
